$description: scrin motion tokens (DTCG 2025.10). UI durations/easing + the logo animation set. build.mjs generates dist/motion/{logo.css,logo-intro.svg,logo-thinking.svg,logo-motion.ts} and android/drawable/avd_scrin_splash.xml from logo.* - edit here only. Every animation has a prefers-reduced-motion fallback (opacity-only, <= reduced.fade).

logo.$description: Logo animation set. Distances are units of the 24-unit mark grid (scale with the icon). The static mark is the final frame of every state.

ease.$description: scrin 'calm arrival' curve - fast start, long soft settle. Logo only.

intro.meaning: two halves (you, them) arrive from opposite corners and draw into one s

thinking.meaning: a signal chases along both halves, half a period apart - data flowing both ways; stops after 4.8 s (< 5 s, WCAG 2.2.2), caller then shows static mark + text

error.meaning: horizontal head-shake while the halves briefly part at the seam - shape change, not colour only

hover.meaning: halves lean apart by <= 2 px at 128 px

morph.meaning: splash mark -> title-bar mark, shared element (view-transition-name: scrin-mark / Motion layoutId)
